name: Skinner
notes: Freedom in safety. Change colours, radius, fonts, nav position and density freely; import/export skin.config.json. A skin is DATA, never code. Every skin passes a gate before it applies: no raw css/script, only the declared editable surface, vault-only assets, and a readability floor so a warning can never be hidden by painting it black on black. The change report is generated, not trusted. Reset is always one click away and cannot be skinned out.
